name: Sergius Bulgakov

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Divine-Humanity (Bogochelovechestvo) which encompasses the uncreated and created natures

VINIT.justification: The apophatic source prior to any revelation or distinction of persons.

TANCH.justification: The final gathering of all creation into the life of the Trinity.

AFWD.justification: The outward movement of God to establish a world distinct from himself.

AREV.justification: The self-emptying descent of the Word into the conditions of finite existence.

CLINK.justification: The sequential cooperation between divine grace and human freedom.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-recognition of the divine and human natures in the single person of Christ.

FSPLIT.justification: The division of Wisdom into Divine Sophia (uncreated) and Creaturely Sophia (created).

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of the two Sophic aspects into the single Wisdom of God.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative state of deification where the creature participates in divine life.

EVALF.justification: The negative state of falling away from the sophic ground of being.

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous holding of contradictory truths that exceed rational logic.

IFIX.justification: The permanent fixation of revealed truth in the life of the Church.

phase_3.void_description: The pre-ontological silence of the Father before the generation of the Son.
phase_3.true_description: The light of Tabor signifying the transfiguration of the world.
phase_3.false_description: The ontological void of the lie which seeks to exist apart from God.
phase_3.both_description: The Chalcedonian definition where two natures exist without confusion or division.

steps.domain_action: The apophatic silence precedes the act of revelation.
The Father speaks the Word to initiate the creation of the cosmos.
The single Wisdom of God branches into the uncreated prototype and the created image.
The uncreated Sophia remains the eternal foundation in the Godhead.
The creaturely Sophia descends into the temporal process of becoming.
The fall introduces a state of alienation within the creaturely branch.
The antinomy of God being both transcendent and immanent is maintained.
The incarnation links the divine purpose with the historical process.
Christ identifies himself as the bridge between the two Sophic modes.
The uncreated and created Wisdom are reunited in the person of the God-man.
The council records the permanent truth of the union of natures.
All things are sealed in the final restoration of the Kingdom.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Holy Spirit who interprets the divine will into the life of the Church.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The liturgy which facilitates the exchange between the human and the divine.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: Holy Tradition which preserves the continuity of the sophic experience.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Providence which governs the timing of redemptive events in history.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Holy Scriptures and the Patristic witness.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The sacrificial love (agape) required for every act of communion.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: The separation of the creature from the creator.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: The integration of the creature into the divine life.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The energy expended in kenosis is recovered in the glory of theosis.
